title: Advanced Search Tip for LinkedIn: How to Exclude a Company from Your LinkedIn Search Results
description:
52 million people use LinkedIn to search for jobs each week—but not everyone is using the platform most effectively. Here's an advanced search tip for LinkedIn to help weed out overwhelming results from just ONE company. 

You can also use this Boolean search tip to extract a software or skill from your job search and exclude certain results.
